# `Q-25-3` — npm component sources are not supported yet

> A component's `src` is an `npm:` package specifier. Only project files are supported for now; the entry is skipped.

## What this means

`src: npm:<package>@<version>` is reserved for loading a published
component through the page's import map. That route is not built yet
(it is deferred in the design, pending a way to vendor the package into
the output), so Quarto warns and skips the entry.

## Why this happens

- The entry uses the `npm:` prefix.

## How to fix

Copy or build the component into a file in the project and point `src:`
at it. Keep the `npm:` line out until the feature lands.

## Related

- The components guide (`docs/guides/authoring/components.qmd`) describes
  the `components:` key, the element contract and the runtime.
